subject: [hw] DEC02: measured VDEC page list (18 pages, 31% need VDEC_ALL, larb SLP_CON +0x00c only, no GCE)
body:
Deliverable page list for the kernel. Host only (phone vpud on T02 fake, DEC1 reference driver + my n2tr recorder); nothing on the phone. Full document: gpu/hwcodec/facts/vdec_trace/PAGES.md (regenerated by facts/vdec_trace/run.sh, deterministic).

Every touched 4 KiB page of 0x16000000..0x1603ffff, both 320x240 (12 AUs, -bf 2) and 1920x1080 (6 AUs, -bf 0), all R+W:

  0x00000 BASE (VDE)        0x0f000 SOC_GCON (VDE)     0x21000 MC (VDE2)
  0x02000 SOC_2000 (VDE)    0x10000 LAT_MISC (VDE)     0x22000 AVC_VLD (VDE2)
  0x04000 RACING (VDE)      0x11000 LAT_VLD (VDE)      0x23000 AVC_MV (VDE2)
  0x0d000 LARB5 (VDE)       0x12000 LAT_AVC_VLD (VDE)  0x24000 PP (VDE2)
                            0x13000 LAT_MV (VDE)       0x25000 MISC (VDE2)
                            0x16000 LAT_16000 (VDE)    0x2e000 LARB4 (VDE2)
                                                       0x2f000 VDEC_SYS (VDE2)

Untouched: every page in 0x30000..0x3ffff and all pages not listed (PAGES.md section 2 lists them).

Key numbers [V, counters]:
- 6180 of 19653 register ops on 320x240 (31%) are outside all ten frozen windows and need RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL.  The rest are served by windows VDEC_BASE/VLD/MC/MV/MISC/LAT_MISC/LAT_VLD/RACING/SOC_GCON/SYS.
- The page->domain rule from DEC07 is exactly right: every touched page < 0x20000 needs VDE (VDEC_SOC), every touched page >= 0x20000 needs VDE2 (VDEC_CORE).  Reached with VDE+VDE2 powered.
- larb5 0x1600d000 and larb4 0x1602e000 are written ONLY at +0x00c: SLP_CON bit0=1 then bit0=0, and the vendor polls bit16 (vdec_hal_wait_larb_sleep_protect libvcodec_utility 0x292e8).  Read-only breaks decode; allow write to +0x00c only, as DEC07 proposes.
- init and header phases issue ZERO VDEC register accesses: SPS/PPS are parsed in ARM code from the mapped bitstream; the first register access is in the first frame START.  A header-only milestone needs no VDEC register window.
- GCE: 0 flushes, 0 commands in a 12-AU session.  All programming is direct MMIO, so one RWVC_REGS batch per run of adjacent ops is enough; no CMDQ needed.
- Per frame: 490 raw reads + 574 raw writes, of which 433 distinct read offsets + 422 distinct write offsets; resolution-independent (same 433/422 at 1080p).  Raw is higher because the fake does not answer the BASE+0x2004 status poll and the AVC_VLD barrel-shifter read early.
- The old ten windows cover 13473/19653; VDEC_ALL adds 6180 (and covers the 1080p set identically).

Evidence: facts/vdec_trace/PAGES.md sections 1-4, COST.md sections 1-4; run.sh output N2TEST DEC02 PASS 10/10 (access multiset and PAGES.md identical twice).  hw-d01: facts for FACTS.md are in STATUS.md section 5; the two most important: (a) vsi.dec is at 0x1a30 because VIDEO_MAX_FRAME=64, (b) the vendor get_ringbuf ring key is vsi.dec.vdec_bs_va (0x1ac8), zero => the get_ringbuf blocker.
